findings.title: Reuse the validated sequence bound when capturing compatibility arguments
findings.description: The helper accepts collections.abc.Sequence, validates len(active)-start and reserves count work, then calls len(active) again to select the iteration range. A valid custom Sequence can return different lengths. Additional empty exact-str tokens consume byte capacity but no per-token work and are appended without a second record-count check. Both validator and shared report routing consume this helper.

finite_source_trace.kind: Source-derived exact control trace; no behavioral execution claimed
finite_source_trace.input: Sequence[str] whose first __len__ returns 1, second returns 100001, and __getitem__ returns the empty exact str for each requested index
finite_source_trace.result: The helper can return 100001 tokens despite the 100000-token count limit. Work/count prepaid for one token does not cover the actual capture.
finite_source_trace.scope: Bounded 100001-element mathematical trace; no hostile filesystem, process, network or production invocation.

findings.repair_direction: Capture end = len(active) once, derive count = end - start, and iterate range(start, end) only after validating/reserving that count. Preserve exact-string checks, text reservations and rejection behavior.
findings.required_regression: Small memory-only changing-length Sequence: make a second length observation grow beyond a tiny limit or raise, verify only the validated first bound is used and no extra indexes are accessed. Retain count and text-before-traversal controls.

Canonical routes and eight wrappers forward fixed installed suffixes and preserve exit codes; compatibility validators do not authorize installed v2 operations.
Report route selection uses bounded exact tokens and rejects mixed option families; report implementations remain outside this review.
Pure validator modules remain byte-identical. Intent documentation and retained legacy error/read behavior otherwise match the scoped contract.
